postFieldResults.description: See a 65-inch Samsung OLED and Bose soundbar installation on a stone fireplace in Glenview, IL, with a Sanus mount secured to wood studs.
An 85-inch Neo QLED and soundbar installation above a brick fireplace in Wilmette, IL, using a Sanus mount and masonry anchors.
A 77-inch LG W6 fireplace installation in Winnetka, IL, with a recessed media box, Sonos Arc Ultra mount and LG Zero Connect Box.
An 85-inch Samsung Frame TV mounted on drywall with wood studs in Glenview, IL, using a Sanus Preferred full-motion mount.
A Samsung Frame Pro fireplace installation in Evanston, IL, with a recessed outlet and a connection to a Sonos Amp in the basement.
An 85-inch Sony BRAVIA and Sonos Arc Ultra installation in Winnetka, IL. Explore the project details and installation photographs.
A 77-inch LG G6 installation with a Legrand recessed media box in Glenview, IL. View the project details and installation gallery.
A 55-inch Samsung OLED installed on tile with a MantelMount MAX1 in Evanston, IL. Explore the installation details and project photographs.
A 77-inch LG C6 and Samsung Q990H soundbar installation in Evanston, IL, with concealed connecting cables and a recessed box for power equipment.
A 77-inch LG G6 television installed on a stone fireplace in Winnetka, IL. Explore the project details and installation photographs.
An 85-inch Samsung Neo QLED wall installation in Evanston, IL, with a recessed media box and concealed wiring behind the screen.
See our TV wall-mounting project in Wilmette, IL. Watch the original Chicago Mounting installation video and view the project overview.
An outdoor TV and soundbar mounted on brick beneath a covered patio in Glenview, IL. See the installation photograph and project overview.
See a Samsung Frame TV mounted above a tiled fireplace with a soundbar below the screen. Explore the installation overview, photograph and video.
